data.short_meaning: A gentle sea current or wave
data.long_meaning: A gentle sea current that calms the waves and brings serenity to the sea. The name Hadal carries the meaning “A gentle sea current or wave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Hadal usually hope their child will grow to embody a gentle sea current or wave and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: حدل

in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مشتق من الجذر حدل، و يعني الشدة و العنف و القوة، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و الصلابة في اللغة العربية، و يستخدم في بعض الأحيان ليدل على الشخصية القوية و الصارمة.

in_urdu.name: حدل
in_urdu.meaning: حدل نام کا مطلب ہے شدت، سختی، اور قوت
in_urdu.long_meaning: حدل نام عربی زبان کے جذر حدل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے شدت، سختی، اور قوت۔ یہ نام ان شخصیتوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو مضبوط، صارم، اور غیر متزلزل ہوتی ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان معاشرے میں، یہ نام ان بچوں کے لیے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے جو زندگی میں مضبوطی اور ثبات کے ساتھ آگے بڑھیں۔

in_hindi.name: हदल
in_hindi.meaning: हदल नाम का अर्थ है तीव्रता, कठोरता और शक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: हदल नाम अरबी भाषा के मूल जड़ حدल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है तीव्रता, कठोरता और शक्ति। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन बच्चों के लिए चुना जाता है जो जीवन में मजबूत और अटल हो। यह नाम उन व्यक्तित्वों के लिए उपयुक्त है जो दृढ़, साहसी और नेतृत्व करने की क्षमता वाली होती हैं।

in_english.name: Hadal
in_english.meaning: Hadal means intensity, severity, and strength in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hadal originates from the Arabic root 'حدل' (hadala), which signifies intensity, severity, and strength. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with strong and resolute personalities. Historically, it has been used to denote individuals with firm and unyielding characteristics. The name holds spiritual significance as it reflects the attributes of resilience and determination. Across Muslim cultures, Hadal is chosen for its powerful connotation and its roots in Arabic linguistic heritage.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hadal holds cultural significance in the Islamic world as it is derived from the Arabic term "hadā'", which means "gentleness" or "serenity". This term is often used in reference to the calming effects of the current of the same name in the Atlantic Ocean, which is believed to have a semi-permanent nature and plays a crucial role in shaping the climate of the region. The name symbolizes the beauty and tranquility of nature, which is highly valued and celebrated in Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, Hadal represents the gentle currents of divine guidance and inspiration that flow through us, helping us navigate the choppy waters of life and find inner peace and serenity. It serves as a reminder of the One who calms our chaotic hearts and minds, gives direction to our lives, and illuminates our paths. By invoking the name Hadal, believers seek to align themselves with the gentle currents of God's will, trusting in His guidance and surrendering to His plan for their lives. This spiritual significance of Hadal connects us to the divine wisdom and compassion, reminding us of the eternal and unchanging nature of God's love and mercy.

historical_references.reference: The Hadal Sea, also known as the Abyssal Sea, is believed to be the deepest part of the Earth's oceans, extending beyond the Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench to about 32,000 feet (10,000 meters) deep. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'hadal', which means 'deep' or 'abyss'.

The term 'hadal' also appears in Islamic literature, specifically in the context of the Quranic verse 'And it is He Who raised you up from the lowest of the earth to the highest of it, and has given you the means of hearing and seeing. And He will yet guide you to the right path.' (Surah Ar-Ra'd, 13:11). In this context, 'hadal' is believed to refer to the lowest depths of the Earth, and the verse is a reminder of God's power and ability to raise humans from the depths to the heights of life.
